Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory207.png'}
{3: 'It was a sunny afternoon at the harbor. Confetti from celebratory cannons fluttered down like colorful rain, and beneath that bright shower, a crowd stood cheering.'}
{3: 'Their gaze was fixed on the sea beyond, where several research ships floated. One bore a massive yellow crane at its prow.'}
{3: 'Dangling beneath that crane, nearly ten meters long, was an enormous black sphere.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Reporter', 3: 'And here it is! The star of the day, the final and most vital piece of the Millennium Project!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Reporter', 3: 'Mr. Helio, on such a momentous occasion, would you say a few words for us, to the crowd here and everyone watching at home?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Not far from the harbor, a cordoned-off clearing had been set aside for a privileged, close-up view of the sphere. The reporter led the camera crew through the crowd and found the man in charge at its center, surrounded by onlookers.'}
{3: 'Dressed in a crisp suit, he flinched slightly when the microphone was suddenly thrust toward him. A surprised sound escaped his lips, then stopped short.'}
{3: 'Under the weight of all those eager stares from the reporter and the crowd, he let his gaze travel around the gathering, and finally out toward the sphere.'}
{3: 'Then, in a single moment, a light kindled deep in his eyes. A warm, unguarded smile broke across his face, and he leaned toward the microphone and began to speak.'}
{2: '"Helio"', 3: "It will dive into the endless deep for us, bear the loneliness we can't, and then... find the meaning of life."}

{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '3'}
{2: '—The Millennium Project—'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}
{1: 'KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY'}
{3: 'LOCATION: KURONO VESSEL, SHIP CABIN. NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY.'}
{1: '1', 2: '???', 3: '...Seizing my gear, restricting my movement. Is this what Kurono calls a "rendezvous"?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The room has been cleared out in a hurry. Scuff marks from dragged supplies streak the floor, and stray tags still cling to the walls.'}
{3: 'Apart from these traces, the space holds only a long table at its center, with chairs arranged on either side, facing one another.'}
{3: 'By the door, a Kurono soldier keeps watch. And there sits Adelyde herself, upright and utterly still, offering no trace of discomfort at the circumstances.'}
{2: 'System', 3: 'Beep.'}
{3: 'Behind the soldier, the door emits a confirming chime as the passcode is accepted, then swings open.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Military Officer', 3: "You're dismissed.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurono Construct', 3: 'Yes, sir.', 4: '1'}
{3: "A man in an officer's uniform enters through the doorway. With a brief glance, he signals to the soldier outside, who promptly withdraws from the door."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Military Officer', 3: 'Now.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'The hatch closes with a soft hiss, sealing away every sound from beyond. The man pulls out a chair and settles into it, his piercing gaze locked onto Adelyde, brimming with barely contained anger. A cold scoff escapes him as he gestures over the tabletop, bringing a holographic screen to life.'}
{2: 'Military Officer', 3: "Before we get started, let's make one thing clear. You're going to know exactly who you're dealing with.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Clausen, captain of this Kurono transoceanic vessel. The ****ing ship that can't follow its original course because of you.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Hello, Captain.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Is that all you've got to say, Adelyde? ADELYDE HELIO! Don't think for a second that your pedigree impresses me. Descendant of the four great families, F.O.S. Instructor. You think any of that puts you above me here?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I don't, Captain Clausen. May I ask where this ship is currently headed?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'There are no windows in this room.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Clausen', 3: "You know damn well where we're headed. This ship is part of Babylonia's reinforcement fleet to the Atlantic. Where else would we be going besides that dam called the Atlantic Eye?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'But aside from the Balder in the reports, no other ship should be capable of sailing directly into the "red sea," correct?', 4: '2'}
{3: "A satellite map of the Transatlantic Economic Community's waters flickers onto the screen, where Babylonia's reinforcements are pouring in from every corner of the world."}
{3: 'Their trajectories all bend toward one destination: the Atlantic Eye, the very dam that has been gushing Red Tide into the ocean ever since the moon rock kinetic strike.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg1601_7.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg1601_7.jpg'}

{3: 'The Red Tide is swallowing the ocean at a devastating speed, turning it into an impassable "red sea." And so, despite the urgency of the situation, the reinforcements cannot simply charge straight into the Atlantic Eye.'}
{3: 'They are forced to circle its perimeter instead, probing and scouting, hunting for a safe corridor or at least a point near enough to gamble on a desperate push.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: 'I thought command gave me this mission so I could bring in someone from the Atlantic, someone who actually knows the area, to find us the shortest route into the dam. Put us ahead of the pack.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'So what the hell was that explosion? By the time our ship got there, the nearby current devices had already been caught in the blast. All of them, destroyed.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Clausen', 3: "And the one transmitting signals from the center of that explosion... that was you, Adelyde! You set it off, didn't you? And thanks to your little stunt, my ship is stuck taking the long way around.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'What happens when we fall behind everyone else? What if that blast had caught my ship too?', 4: '1'}
{3: "Clausen's agitation builds with every word, and his palm strikes the table hard."}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'I know how the politics work back on Babylonia, Adelyde. So tell me, did you cause that explosion because you had a problem with the rendezvous order?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "I'm asking you straight. Are you trying to go up against Kurono?!", 4: '1'}

{3: "Clausen's rage crests on that last word, his shout filling every corner of the cabin. A short silence follows. When he appears to have regained some composure, Adelyde shifts in her seat and begins to speak."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Yes. I caused the explosion.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "But it was never aimed at Kurono. You and I were both ordered to rendezvous here. That means, for the time being, we're partners.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So, Captain Clausen, why not take a breath and hear your "partner\'s" real goal?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: '...You talk a good game. Fine. Let\'s hear it, then. This "real goal" of yours.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The Millennium Project.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I only wanted to bring back a legacy from the Golden Age.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1014.jpg'}
{1: 'The Golden Age was beautiful in every way.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'People gathered up the futures imagined by those who came before and brought them into being, one after another.'}

{1: 'In those years, humanity saw the possibility of colonizing the stars on a grand scale, watched fully independent machine intelligence emerge from theory into the world, and glimpsed, perhaps for the first time, a direction in which life could truly advance.'}
{1: 'These triumphs pushed scientific fervor to its zenith, and project after project was conceived and set into motion.', 7: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1524.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1524.jpg'}
{1: 'The Millennium Project was one such endeavor. Its architect bore the name Helio, a scion of one of the four great families that governed the Transatlantic Economic Community.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Though the project began as a fairly conventional oceanic research proposal within the Community, this Helio introduced a concept that, even now, sounds almost absurdly ambitious.'}

{1: 'His aim was to send the project descending into the deepest trenches of the Earth, hunting for the        "primordial soup," the theoretical cradle of all life that had only ever existed on paper.'}
{1: 'Anyone can talk big, but not everyone can dream on this scale.'}
{1: "Before long, the project attracted support from every direction. Beyond Dr. Helio's own family, the other three great families—Erhorn, Spelmin, and Copperfield—all signed on."}
{1: "Each family offered its distinct expertise and the era's most advanced technologies, and each owned a node bearing its name within the project.", 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory828.jpg'}
{1: '??? UNDERSEA BASE', 2: 'NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY, DEPTH: 300 METERS', 4: 'SOMETIME EARLIER'}
{3: 'SOMETIME EARLIER. LOCATION: ??? UNDERSEA BASE, NORTHERN WATERS, TRANSATLANTIC ECONOMIC COMMUNITY TERRITORY. DEPTH: 300 METERS.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'One of those nodes is where I\'m standing right now. It\'s a deep-sea base led by the Helio family that served as an oceanic engineering hub, a cluster of specialized work platforms. They called it "Moses".', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Adelyde swept her gaze across the undersea base, where nothing but weak emergency lights pushed back against the dark. She recorded her observations and moved forward with caution.'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "The interior's taken heavy damage, but at least the worst hasn't happened.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Corruption was the worst-case scenario.'}
{3: 'Once the Red Tide was confirmed to be pouring from the Atlantic Eye, Babylonia rushed reinforcements to the area with orders to contain the crisis at all costs.'}

{3: 'Around the same time, an operator Adelyde knew well passed along a troubling piece of intelligence: the monitoring satellites had picked up signals suggesting the Millennium Project was active once more.'}
{3: "Signals from an abandoned project were hardly headline news. The problem was that the Millennium Project's machinery embodied the finest work of every great family."}

{3: "If the Red Tide had already reached and corrupted those systems, the project would become a weapon in the enemy's hands. But if the systems remained untouched, then Adelyde had a chance. She might find a way to bring the project back online."}
{3: 'And turn this Golden Age legacy into a tool for the present fight.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory546.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Operator', 3: "That's the objective. Given the personnel shortage, though, confirming the signal will have to be a solo mission, Lieutenant Colonel Adelyde. Is that acceptable to you?", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I know there are more critical situations demanding attention, but we can't leave this unattended either. I'll be fine going alone. If anything unusual comes up, I'll have the discretion to handle it on my own judgment, correct?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Operator', 3: 'Correct. General Wells has already granted you operational discretion, Lieutenant Colonel.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Then arrange a submersible for me. Let's see how far I can get.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Operator', 3: "I'll send you the signal data we detected along with the relevant files. Good luck out there, Lieutenant Colonel.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory773.jpg'}
{3: "Adelyde took the mission. Alone, she traveled to the remote waters that had given up the Millennium Project's signal."}
{3: 'She located the entrance to Moses, descended into the structure, and confirmed within moments that the Punishing Virus had never reached this place.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory828.jpg'}
{3: "Yet the state of the interior was hardly promising. The facility was in no condition to serve as anyone's salvation."}
{3: 'Rust crept across the metal panels, and neglect had left nearly every piece of equipment dead and unresponsive.'}

{3: 'Seawater, seeping in from some unseen rupture, now covered her ankles. Overhead, frayed cables hung down in tangled clusters, and the red emergency signs threw broken reflections onto the dark water below.'}
{3: 'Along the crumbling corridor, abandoned rooms sat with their doors wide open. Inside one of them, Adelyde discovered a terminal that still flickered with power.'}
{2: 'Terminal Voice', 3: 'Welcome to Moses Undersea Observatory Station No. 25.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'This is the project overview...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Terminal Voice', 3: 'Moses is a proprietary module developed by the Helio family. It is, in essence, an experimental system for manipulating ocean-current gravitational fields.'}

{2: 'Terminal Voice', 3: 'By combining high-pressure fluid fields on the seafloor with gravitational micro-perturbation technology, Moses can forcibly displace seawater within a designated area and expose the ocean bed. This greatly reduces the deep-sea pressure burden on detection equipment and enables humanity to explore greater depths.'}
{2: 'Terminal Voice', 3: 'In addition, this node conducts research into deep-sea habitation environments and the viability of permanent human settlement on the ocean floor.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Settling on the ocean floor... Could it be...', 4: '1'}

{3: "Adelyde dismissed the terminal's introduction and went straight for the file archive. The directory stretched before her, dense with system logs that Moses had been quietly compiling all on its own."}

{2: '"Moses"', 3: 'Dossier TT-X0127. As of the current project timestamp, this node has established over 30 undersea bases for the project. At full capacity, all bases combined can accommodate a minimum of 3000 personnel.'}

{2: '"Moses"', 3: 'Dossier TT-X0266. Node construction has reached 4500 meters. Preparing to attempt the next phase breakthrough. Preliminary research underway. Time to celebrate. An extended holiday for all detection machines.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: '4500 meters... I never knew the TEC had the capability to build this deep. But if Moses can really do what it claims...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Then maybe it could tilt the ocean surface and force the Red Tide to flow in another direction.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'That thought stuck with me, so I kept digging through the files, hoping I could find a way to activate Moses or take control of it.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Halfway. That's as far as I got.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: 'Halfway?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The archives showed that Moses built its final undersea base at 5600 meters. After that, material strength issues brought everything to a halt.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The node ran its own calculations, hit a dead end, and could only wait for further instructions. Those instructions never came. The Punishing Virus hit first.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "So what? You already said the place wasn't corrupted.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "It wasn't. But the outbreak triggered a failsafe protocol across the entire Millennium Project.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'All four nodes were cut off from the master AI called Abyss Passer. And without it, Moses had no way to reach the outside world.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Hold on. A master AI? You're telling me there's a central system that ties all the modules together?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "That's right. And based on my assessment, if we can reconnect the node to the master AI, we can bring it back online.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Clausen', 3: "Then you must've made the connection already...? No, wait. The base you described was falling apart. Could it even link back to the master AI in that state?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I was getting to that.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory828.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Despite how it looked, Moses had done everything it could to keep itself going. To keep the deep-sea station running.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'While I was going through the archives, I started to notice something. Eyes watching me from the dark. No hostility, just... watching.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I moved closer and realized they were small maintenance bots. They had no speech functions, but their bodies and arms kept swaying. It was almost like they were happy to see me there.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory828.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory828.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'They wanted me to follow. So I set the terminal aside and let them lead me through a dark passage. And soon, I realized there was another space tucked away beyond it.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory937.png'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: "A hidden room, lit up and spotless. Those maintenance bots had kept it cleaner than a hotel room. You'd never guess the base had ever been through a crisis.", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'The bots clustered around me, guiding me deeper inside. And there, I saw a supply crate.', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'There were food rations, diving suits, and combat gear. Everything a human might need. Everything they could scavenge from the base, gathered and stacked right there.', 4: '18'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory937.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory937.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Behind the crate was a Moses sub-terminal. It displayed the last message logged before the system went into hibernation.', 4: '18'}
{2: '"Moses"', 3: '"Sad. Don\'t want to stop." Request to any human who arrives here: please help us reconnect to the master AI. Please let the Millennium Project continue.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1301.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Clausen', 3: "Wait. Don't tell me that thing actually awakened.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "I doubt it. If you look at the earlier reports, Moses' language database has always been weird. That phrasing is likely just how its creator built it.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Anyway. Before I came here, I pulled every file I could get my hands on.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'With help from someone I know, I found an emergency connection code that could reconnect the node to the master AI, even after the failsafe triggered.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So I brought Moses out of hibernation, entered the code, and initiated the connection between Moses and the master AI designated Abyss Passer...', 4: '1'}
